B is better. Both answers are under 120 words and correctly say Viking warriors didn't wear horned helmets. B is more accurate on the Bronze Age detail: the Veksø helmets predate the Viking Age by well over a millennium, while A's "centuries before" understates the gap. B also names the specific artists behind the 19th-century image, Malmström and Doepler, where A names only Doepler.

B
